summary: Fast autonomous execution is defensible only when impact is bounded, evidence is observable, recovery is tested and approval occurs at a consequence-appropriate boundary.

points.text: Enforce filesystem, network, credential, spend and deployment limits outside the model; natural-language prohibitions are guidance, not rails.
Default to reversible branches, disposable environments and idempotent operations, and test rollback before increasing autonomy.
Record action provenance and surface compact review evidence at the merge or release gate so speed inside the sandbox does not overwhelm reviewers.
